mapper.sql: id, template_code, channel, recipient, title, body, payload, status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_at, error_message, sent_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT , payload::text AS payload FROM ainer_notification_record WHERE id = #{id}

WITH claimed AS ( SELECT id FROM ainer_notification_record WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'SENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE ainer_notification_record SET status = 'SENDING', updated_at = #{now} FROM claimed WHERE ainer_notification_record.id = claimed.id RETURNING ainer_notification_record.id, template_code, channel, recipient, title, body, payload::text AS payload, ainer_notification_record.status, retry_count, max_retries, next_retry_at, error_message, sent_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE ainer_notification_record SET status = CASE WHEN #{retryCount} + 1 >= #{maxRetries} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
